messages:
erin: Heads-up — FinApps opened a ticket claiming our hosted chat assistant became noticeably more terse after last night's model push. They attached side-by-side outputs and a small repro.
erin: Customer quote: "Previously the assistant gave step-by-step guidance and offered follow-ups. Now it returns a one-liner with no follow-ups."
priya: Which model did they hit?
erin: They show requests against model=rdx-clarity-v3.5. We rolled v3.4 -> v3.5 at 2026-03-15 02:15 UTC. ops-bot posted rollout at 02:10.
ops-bot: Deploy rdx-clarity-v3.5 to hosted cluster eu-west-1 finished — rollout 02:15 UTC — tag: release/2026-03-15/clarity
finapps-bot: New ticket #F-7421 from FinApps — summary: answers lost elaboration after model upgrade; severity: medium
erin: They pasted a tiny repro curl: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-clarity-v3.5","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"How do I reset the user's 2FA settings in our dashboard?"}],"max_tokens":120}'
```
erin: Their v3.4 example (what they said used to get):
```
Assistant: To reset 2FA: 1) Navigate to Admin > Users, 2) search by email, 3) click "Reset 2FA", 4) confirm. Tell the user to re-enroll and include this support doc link. Want the CLI command?
```
erin: Their v3.5 example:
```
Assistant: Go to Admin > Users, select the user, reset 2FA.
```
tom: Clear drop in elaboration and no offer to follow up. Any chance of truncation at the app layer? token limit?
priya: I checked their request body, response body, and connection logs they attached. No truncated transfer, latency fine (~120ms p50), no 502/504s, and content-length is tiny — the model returned a short string.
jules: In the release notes we ran a concision prompt tweak for demo mode. I thought it was gated; maybe the gating misfired.
priya: Confirmed — we changed the assistant system instruction to bias towards brevity for a demo experiment. It looks like the gating flag didn't stick for some hosted traffic.
erin: FinApps says they never change their prompt; their example is literally just the user question above.
support_lead: Plan: 1) Support reproduce with pinned v3.4 vs v3.5 and include raw diffs. 2) Eng run A/B over canonical support queries (50). Collect metrics: token count, follow-up presence, and simple quality scores. 3) Short-term mitigation: patch system prompt to restore follow-up behavior or expose a per-request assistant_instructions override.
priya: Kicking off ab-run now. Also checking inference graph for any post-processing policy that might strip assistant trailing sentences.
tom: Pulling inference logs and kernel traces; watching KV-cache and prefix handling.
erin: I'll give FinApps a suggested workaround: add "assistant_instructions": "please include step-by-step instructions and offer follow-up questions" in the request until we fix it.
priya: Preliminary A/B: v3.5 token count down ~33% vs v3.4; follow-up-question rate down ~62% across the seed set. Uploading full CSV to the ticket.
ops-bot: CI ab-test job #4286 started (v3.4 vs v3.5) — expected finish ~30m
jules: Should we hotfix release to revert the concision change or flip the experiment off?
support_lead: Make a rollback candidate if the A/B confirms regression and customer impact is material. Otherwise push a patch to system prompt config and gate the concision tweak. Tag: RED-INC-4921, priority: high, assign @priya.
priya: Creating regression ticket and attaching customer repro and our AB results. Will propose a minimal prompt patch to restore follow-ups; can ship as hotfix if approved.
erin: Updated FinApps with interim workaround and ETA: EOD for confirmation, earlier if hotfix accepted. They appreciated the fast reply. :thumbsup:
support_lead: Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread.
priya: Will post results and the proposed patch in ~25m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
